study: Culliney et al. 2019 — Integrating English (LiLAC genre-pedagogy CPD) EEF cluster RCT
delivery_evidence: Core delivery in person: 'Five one-day accredited modules were attended by teachers in person' at five regional hubs (non-school venues), with reading/homework between sessions; supplemented by ongoing trainer support via email and the FRONTER online VLE (supplementary, not a core component). (Intervention/delivery section, p. ~13)
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are broad independent standardized assessments: KS2 Writing (a national past-paper test) plus KS2 Reading and KS2 GPS from the National Pupil Database; none tailored to the LiLAC content. (Table 8, p. 26)
curriculum_evidence: LiLAC is a CPD training course providing teachers with linguistic/pedagogical strategies (genre pedagogy) to improve how they teach writing within existing English provision; teachers produce their own schemes of work and buy only the LiLAC manual — no new pupil curriculum/textbook is adopted. (Intervention description, pp. ~12-13)
outcome_timing_evidence: All ITT outcomes measured summer 2018 at the end of Year 6 / end of the two-year trial. (Table 8, p. 26; timepoint 'post (summer 2018, end of trial)')
